item.text: {"summary":"The four failing groups share the signed and unsigned integer parsing paths, and the failures involve hexadecimal prefixes with no payload. The supplied excerpts show those paths call shared parsing helpers, but do not include the helper implementations or enough of the current assertions to establish the required behavior and repair boundary.","hypotheses":["The shared sign/base parser consumes a hexadecimal prefix but leaves an empty digit sequence that the integer parsers reject.","The inferred-base entry point and explicit-base entry points use different prefix handling, so the regression may affect more than the shared signed and unsigned helpers."],"queries":["safe_parse_sign_and_base","safe_parse_positive_int","SimpleAtoi"],"reads":[{"path":"absl/strings/numbers.cc","line":1020,"symbol":"safe_parse_sign_and_base"},{"path":"absl/strings/numbers_test.cc","line":2140,"symbol":"StrToInt32Base.PrefixOnly"},{"path":"absl/strings/numbers.h","line":80,"symbol":"SimpleAtoi"},{"path":"absl/strings/numbers.cc","line":1090,"symbol":"safe_parse_positive_int"}],"ready":false}
